{{family name hatnote|[[Liu]]|lang=Chinese}}

'''Liu Yuanfang''' ({{zh|s=刘元方}}; born February 1931) is a Chinese nuclear chemist. He is a chemist at the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS), who is now Professor of Chemistry at [[Shanghai University]].{{Citation needed|date=October 2020}} He has studied nuclear chemistry and radiochemistry for forty years and pioneered education in that field in China.<ref>{{cite web|title=刘元方 (Yuanfang Liu)|url=http://www.shu.edu.cn/Default.aspx?tabid=8556|accessdate=9 December 2010}}</ref>
